sections.label: Best of the Day
sections.slate: Friday this tab went 1-0 (Pacers). Today: four sources agree on the Monday night Under.

straight.reasoning: TheSpread, WagerTalk, SportsBettingDime and Yahoo all take the Under. Jacoby Brissett makes his first Ravens start with Lamar Jackson on injured reserve, and Baltimore hasn't reached 14 points in any of its four straight losses. The 0-8 Chargers haven't topped 17 in six of eight games, Herbert has a finger injury, and McConkey is out. About 83% of the money is on the Over, but the total hasn't moved up. Lines range from 38.5 to 39.5 at different books; take the highest one you can find. Playable to 38.5.

sections.label: NBA
sections.slate: Nine games tonight, starting at 4:00 PM PT. Dimers and BettingPros agree on Chicago getting 9.5 in Cleveland. Other games had split or thin signals, so they're skipped.

straight.reasoning: Two sources agree. Cleveland is 7-7, ranks 21st in defense, and is without Evan Mobley. Chicago lost recent close games to the 76ers (by 6) and Spurs (by 5), and Norman Powell has scored 24+ in back-to-back games. Dimers' model gives the Bulls a 53% chance to cover. Playable to +9; skip at +8.5.

sections.label: Football
sections.slate: Monday Night Football: Chargers @ Ravens, 5:15 PM PT on ESPN. Ravens -4.5 (opened -3.5), total 38.5–39.5. Jacoby Brissett starts for Baltimore (Lamar Jackson is on injured reserve), and Justin Herbert has a finger injury.

straight.reasoning: Four sources agree, both offenses are struggling, and both quarterbacks are in tough spots. Take the highest total you can find. Playable to 38.5.

props.reasoning: SportsBettingDime: he's averaged 184 passing yards over his last six games and stayed under 200 in four of them, he has a finger injury, and McConkey is out. If Herbert is ruled out, the bet is usually voided. Quarter unit.
